He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma Sooners]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). ==High school career== Fears played basketball at [[Joliet West High School]] in [[Joliet, Illinois]] as a sophomore with his older brother, [[Jeremy Fears Jr.|Jeremy]], prior to transferring to AZ Compass Prep for his junior year.{{cite web |last1=O'Brien |first1=Michael |title=Joliet native Jeremiah Fears enters NBA Draft after one season at Oklahoma |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/high-school-basketball/2025/04/03/jeremiah-fears-nba-draft-basketball-oklahoma-joliet |website=Chicago Sun-Times |access-date=June 24, 2025 |date=April 3, 2025}} As a junior, he averaged a team-high 14.2 points along with 3.6 rebounds, 2.3 assists, and 2.5 steals.{{cite web|title=Sooners Add Fears to 2024-25 Roster|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2024/8/19/mens-basketball-fears-set-to-join-sooners-in-2024-25|website=soonersports.com|date=August 19, 2024|access-date=February 4, 2025}} ===Recruiting=== Fears became a consensus four-star prospect and was tabbed as a top-25 guard in the 2025 ESPN 100. On January 22, 2024, he committed to join [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] in 2025 over offers from [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]], [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]], [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]], and [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss]].{{cite web|title=Five-star junior Jeremiah Fears commits to play for Illinois|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39364266/five-star-junior-jeremiah-fears-commits-play-illinois|website=espn.com|date=January 22, 2024|access-date=December 16, 2024}} However on July 1, Fears decommitted from [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] and then committed to [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]] and reclassified into the 2024 class. With his commitment, Fears became the first Oklahoma prospect to be ranked in the top 40 by ESPN since [[Trae Young]].{{cite web|title=Jeremiah Fears commits to Oklahoma, will reclassify|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40605595/jeremiah-fears-commits-oklahoma-reclassify|website=espn.com|date=July 20, 2024|access-date=November 27, 2024}} {{College as an effective ball handler and a dynamic scorer, Fears joined an empty [[2024–25 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|2024–25 Oklahoma Sooners]] backcourt following the transfers of starters Javian McCollum, Otega Oweh, and Milos Uzan. ===Freshman season=== On November 4, 2024, Fears debuted for [[2024–25 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]], recording 16 points, 5 rebounds, 6 assists, and 2 steals off the bench against [[Lindenwood Lions men's basketball|Lindenwood]].{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Sooners vs Lindenwood Lions Box Score, November 4, 2024|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401727313|website=espn.com}} He continued to come off the bench until the Sooners' fourth game against [[East Texas A&M Lions men's basketball|East Texas A&M]] on November 21 where he tallied a game-high 20 points.{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Sooners vs East Texas A&M Lions Box Score, November 21, 2024|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401727258|website=espn.com}} In the 3-game November 27–29 [[Battle 4 Atlantis|2024 Battle 4 Atlantis]], Fears led Oklahoma to an upset win over No. 24 [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] in the semifinals, posting a then season-high 26 points, along with 5 rebounds and 5 assists.{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Sooners vs Arizona Wildcats Box Score, November 28, 2024|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401729741|website=espn.com}} Fears, alongside teammate Jalon Moore, led Oklahoma to the championship, averaging 18.7 points, 5.3 assists, and 2.7 steals, earning himself all-tournament team honors and being named on December 2 as the SEC Freshman of the Week.{{cite web|title=Fears Named SEC Freshman of the Week|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2024/12/2/mens-basketball-fears-named-sec-freshman-of-the-week|website=soonersports.com}} On December 14, Fears posted 17 points and 5 assists in an 80–65 victory over [[Bedlam_Series#Men's_basketball|rival]] [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]].{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Sooners vs Oklahoma State Box Score, December 14, 2024|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401719222/oklahoma-st-oklahoma|website=espn.com}} On December 18 against No. 24 [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] in the [[Jumpman Invitational|2024 Jumpman Invitational]], Fears posted a career-high 30 points, including a game-winning four-point play after being fouled on a made three-pointer with 11.5 seconds remaining.{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Sooners vs Michigan Wolverines Box Score, December 18, 2024|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401716054|website=espn.com}} He became the first Oklahoma true freshman since [[Trae Young]] in 2018 to score 30-plus points. Fears would later earn his second Freshman of the Week award following his performance against [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] and [[Central Arkansas Bears basketball|Central Arkansas]].{{cite web|title=Fears Named SEC Freshman of the Week|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2024/12/23/mens-basketball-fears-named-sec-freshman-of-the-week|website=soonersports.com}} On January 7, 2025, Fears was named as one of 25 midseason finalists for the [[John R. Wooden Award|Wooden Award]].{{cite web|title=Fears Named to Wooden Award Midseason Top 25 Watch List|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2025/1/7/mens-basketball-fears-named-to-wooden-award-midseason-top-25-watch-list|website=soonersports.com}} After going scoreless against [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M]], Fears scored a team-high 21 points on February 1, notching his sixth game of at least 20 points, in a 97–67 victory over No. 24 [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]].{{cite web|title=Oklahoma Routs No. 24 Vanderbilt 97-67 for Third Win in Four Games|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2025/2/1/mens-basketball-huge-second-half-lifts-ou-past-no-24-vanderbilt-97-67|website=soonersports.com}} On February 22 against No. 21 [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State]], Oklahoma snapped a five-game losing streak behind Fears' first career double-double, with 27 points and 10 assists.{{cite web|title=Fears' 27 Points, 10 Assists Lead OU Past No. 21 Mississippi State|url=https://soonersports.com/news/2025/2/22/mens-basketball-fears-27-points-leads-ou-past-no-21-mississippi-state|website=soonersports.com}} On April 2, Fears announced he would declare for the [[2025 NBA Draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/news/oklahoma-freshman-jeremiah-fears-declares-for-nba-draft|title=Oklahoma freshman Jeremiah Fears declares for NBA Draft|website=NBA.com|date=April 2, 2025|access-date=April 3, 2025}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | || .284 || .851 || 4.1 || 4.1 || 1.6 || .1 || 17.1 {{S-end}} ==National team career== Fears was named to the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States Under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2024 FIBA Under-18 AmeriCup]], marking his first national team debut.{{cite web|title=2024 USA Basketball Men's U18 National Team Announced|url=https://www.usab.com/news/2024/05/2024-usa-basketball-mens-u18-national-team-announced|website=usab.com|date=May 28, 2024|access-date=November 27, 2024}} He averaged 6.5 points, 2.7 rebounds, 2.8 assists and a team-high 3.0 steals as Team USA won the gold medal. ==Personal life== Fears' father, Jeremy Fears Sr., played college basketball at [[Ohio Bobcats men's basketball|Ohio]] and earned Mid-American Conference All-Freshman accolades in 2005 before transferring to [[Bradley Braves men's basketball|Bradley]]. His older brother, [[Jeremy Fears Jr.]], plays college basketball for [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]].{{cite web|title=2024-25 Men's Basketball Roster - Jeremiah Fears Bio|url=https://soonersports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jeremiah-fears/18548|website=soonersports.com|access-date=December 16, 2024}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://soonersports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jeremiah-fears/18548 Oklahoma Sooners bio] *[https://www.usab.com/players/jeremiah-fears USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Fears, Jeremiah}} [[Category:2006 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Joliet, Illinois]] [[Category:Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
